fact: In March 2024 the Ministry of Health was digitalising 500 facilities (regional referrals, general hospitals, HC IVs) with point-of-care EMRs, with UgandaEMR+ activated for HIV and TB at 3 of 10 facilities, targeting less-paper by end 2026.
title: National Wide Rollout of UgandaEMRPlus (O3 distro) in Uganda
